recognize_zh: 這是一張流程圖（非型態圖）：由疑似 AL 類澱粉沉積症的臨床線索（眼周紫斑、巨舌等）出發，依序為組織切片 Congo red 確診與分型、找出漿細胞克隆、評估器官侵犯與分期，最後依 NT-proBNP 與體能狀態分成低、中、高風險治療。
features: Top row clinical photos: periorbital purpura, submandibular/neck swelling, and macroglossia with tongue indentation

Side boxes list signs and symptoms of AL (fatigue, weight loss, edema, heart failure, neuropathy, postural hypotension, purpura) and red flags in MGUS/myeloma (unexplained high NT-proBNP, albuminuria)
Diagnostic steps: tissue biopsy with Congo red, amyloid typing by IHC or LC-MS, then clone detection by serum/urine immunofixation, free light chains, marrow biopsy, iFISH, and imaging
Staging step: ECG, echocardiogram, NT-proBNP, troponin T, eGFR, 24-hour proteinuria, alkaline phosphatase, clotting

Risk-adapted therapy: low risk (consider ASCT with high-dose melphalan), intermediate risk (combination such as MDex, CTD, CyBorD, BMDex), high risk with NT-proBNP >8500 ng/L (dose-attenuated regimens with close monitoring)
describe_en: This figure is a non-morphologic diagnostic and treatment algorithm for suspected systemic AL amyloidosis. Clinical clues such as periorbital purpura, macroglossia, and unexplained NT-proBNP elevation or albuminuria in MGUS/myeloma prompt tissue confirmation with Congo red and amyloid typing by immunohistochemistry or mass spectrometry. The plasma cell clone is then characterized by serum and urine immunofixation, free light chains, bone marrow biopsy with iFISH, and imaging, followed by staging of organ involvement with cardiac biomarkers, echocardiography, and renal and hepatic parameters. Treatment is stratified by performance status, troponin T, and NT-proBNP into low-risk (autologous transplant candidates), intermediate-risk (combination chemotherapy), and high-risk (NT-proBNP >8500 ng/L, dose-attenuated therapy) groups.
